# netbox_platform (Data Source)

A NetBox platform (dcim.platform).

From the [official documentation](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/dcim/platform/):

> A platform defines the type of software running on a device or virtual machine. This can be helpful to model when it is necessary to distinguish between different versions or feature sets. Note that two devices of the same type may be assigned different platforms: For example, one Juniper MX240 might run Junos 14 while another runs Junos 15.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_platform" "test" {
  name = "test-platform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `custom_field_filters` (Map of String) Custom field values to match, by field name, e.g. { tier = "gold" }: each entry filters as cf_<field name> with the field's own filter logic, loose (case-insensitive substring) or exact.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `name` (String)
- `name_contains` (String) Case-insensitive substring of the name.
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `slug` (String) URL-friendly unique shorthand; derived from name when not set.
- `tag_slug` (String) Slug of a tag the object carries.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `device_count` (Number) Number of devices using the platform.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `manufacturer_id` (Number) Id of the manufacturer.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `url` (String)
- `virtual_machine_count` (Number) Number of virtual machines using the platform.
